quote: Literacy is the paper boat that carries a child across the ocean of poverty.
explanation: Once they can read, no wave of ignorance can sink them.
long_explanation:
Real education changes how we treat people.

Real learning happens far beyond school walls. It happens whenever someone asks a good question, learns from a mistake, or shares a skill with a friend.

Education is at the very core of Jalte Diye Foundation. When knowledge is shared freely and kindly, it gives people the confidence to shape their own lives.

Share one interesting thing you learned recently with someone who might enjoy hearing it.
